prompt: Grunge and expressionist style artistic illustration of the attached model, painted on a rough and visible canvas texture. The work features dramatic high contrast with a vibrant, saturated red background that fades to black. The model’s body is painted in dark teal and blue-gray tones, with intense red backlighting strongly illuminating her right side, creating a bright red glow at the edges. Gestural, loose and textured brushstrokes can be seen throughout the composition. The background includes black, blurry silhouettes that suggest vegetation. The bottom has a paint splatter and stain effect. Dramatic, tactile and worn atmosphere.

promptTranslations.zh: 粗粝垃圾摇滚与表现主义风格的所附模特艺术插画，绘制在粗糙且清晰可见的画布纹理上。画面具有极强的戏剧性高对比度，背景是鲜艳、饱和的红色并渐变为黑色。模特的身体采用深水鸭蓝和蓝灰冷色调绘制，强烈的红色逆光强烈照亮她的右侧，在边缘营造出鲜艳的红色轮廓光晕。整个构图可见富有表现力、洒脱且具纹理感的笔触。背景包含暗示植被的黑色模糊剪影。底部带有喷溅和污迹效果。呈现出充满戏剧感、触感强烈且粗粝斑驳的氛围。
promptTranslations.zh-TW: 粗獷油漬搖滾與表現主義風格的所附模特兒藝術插畫，繪製在粗糙且清晰可見的畫布紋理上。作品具有戲劇性的高對比度，背景為鮮豔、飽和的紅色並漸變為黑色。模特兒的身體以深水鴨藍與藍灰冷色調繪製，強烈的紅色逆光強烈照亮她的右側，在邊緣營造出鮮明紅色的輪廓光暈。整個構圖可見充滿動勢、寫意且具質感的筆觸。背景包含隱約顯現植物輪廓的黑色模糊剪影。底部帶有顏料飛濺與污漬效果。營造出充滿戲劇感、具觸感且歷經磨損的氛圍。
promptTranslations.ja-JP: グランジおよび表現主義スタイルの、添付モデルの芸術的なイラストレーション。粗く視認できるキャンバスのテクスチャ上に描かれています。この作品は、黒へとフェードする鮮やかで彩度の高い赤の背景を伴う、ドラマチックで強いコントラストが特徴です。モデルの身体はダークティールとブルーグレーのトーンで描かれ、強烈な赤いバックライトが彼女の右側を強く照らし、輪郭に鮮やかな赤い光の輝きを生み出しています。構図全体に身振り的で自由かつ質感のある筆跡が見られます。背景には植物を思わせる黒くぼやけたシルエットが含まれています。底部には絵の具の飛び散りや汚れのエフェクトがあります。ドラマチックで触覚的、そして使い古されたような雰囲気です。
promptTranslations.ko-KR: 거칠고 질감이 뚜렷한 캔버스 위에 그려진 첨부된 모델의 그런지 및 표현주의 스타일 예술적 일러스트레이션. 검은색으로 점차 어두워지는 선명하고 채도 높은 붉은색 배경과 함께 드라마틱한 고대비가 돋보입니다. 모델의 몸은 어두운 틸(청록색)과 블루 그레이 톤으로 채색되어 있으며, 강렬한 붉은 역광이 모델의 오른쪽을 강하게 비추며 가장자리에 밝은 붉은 광채를 만들어냅니다. 구도 전체에 걸쳐 제스처가 느껴지는 자유롭고 질감 있는 붓터치가 드러납니다. 배경에는 식물을 연상시키는 검고 흐릿한 실루엣이 포함되어 있습니다. 하단부에는 물감 튐 및 얼룩 효과가 있습니다. 드라마틱하고 촉각적이며 낡은 듯한 분위기입니다.
promptTranslations.th-TH: ภาพวาดประกอบเชิงศิลปะในสไตล์กรันจ์และเอ็กซ์เพรสชันนิสม์ของนางแบบที่แนบมา วาดลงบนพื้นผิวผ้าใบหยาบที่มองเห็นได้ชัดเจน ผลงานมีความเปรียบต่างสูงที่น่าทึ่งด้วยพื้นหลังสีแดงสดและอิ่มตัวที่ค่อยๆ ไล่เฉดเป็นสีดำ ร่างกายของนางแบบถูกทาสีด้วยโทนสีเขียวอมฟ้าเข้มและสีเทาอมฟ้า พร้อมแสงย้อนสีแดงเข้มข้นที่ส่องสว่างด้านขวาของเธออย่างแรง ทำให้เกิดแสงเรืองรองสีแดงสดใสที่ขอบ สามารถมองเห็นรอยแปรงที่ปล่อยอารมณ์ อิสระ และมีมิติพื้นผิวทั่วทั้งองค์ประกอบ พื้นหลังมีเงาร่างสีดำพร่ามัวที่สื่อถึงพืชพันธุ์ ด้านล่างมีเอฟเฟกต์สีสาดกระเซ็นและคราบเปื้อน บรรยากาศดูดราม่า สัมผัสได้ถึงพื้นผิว และมีร่องรอยสึกหรอ
promptTranslations.vi-VN: Minh họa nghệ thuật theo phong cách grunge và biểu hiện của người mẫu đính kèm, được vẽ trên bề mặt vải canvas thô ráp và rõ nét. Tác phẩm mang độ tương phản cao đầy kịch tính với nền đỏ rực rỡ, bão hòa và mờ dần sang màu đen. Cơ thể của người mẫu được vẽ bằng các tông màu xanh mòng két đậm và xanh xám, với ánh sáng ngược màu đỏ gay gắt chiếu rọi mạnh mẽ vào bên phải của cô ấy, tạo ra vầng sáng đỏ tươi ở các đường viền. Những nét cọ giàu tính biểu cảm, phóng khoáng và có kết cấu rõ rệt xuất hiện khắp bố cục. Hậu cảnh bao gồm các bóng đen mờ ảo gợi lên hình ảnh cây cỏ. Phần đáy có hiệu ứng vết sơn văng và vết ố. Bầu không khí kịch tính, đầy tính xúc giác và phong trần.
promptTranslations.hi-IN: संलग्न मॉडल का ग्रंज और अभिव्यंजनावादी शैली का कलात्मक चित्रण, जिसे एक खुरदरी और स्पष्ट दिखाई देने वाली कैनवास बनावट पर चित्रित किया गया है। यह रचना काले रंग में विलीन होने वाली एक जीवंत, संतृप्त लाल पृष्ठभूमि के साथ नाटकीय उच्च कंट्रास्ट प्रदर्शित करती है। मॉडल के शरीर को गहरे टील और नीले-भूरे रंगों में रंगा गया है, जिसमें एक तीव्र लाल बैकलाइटिंग उसके दाहिने हिस्से को दृढ़ता से रोशन करती है, जिससे किनारों पर एक चमकदार लाल चमक बनती है। पूरी रचना में भावात्मक, ढीले और बनावट वाले ब्रशस्ट्रोक देखे जा सकते हैं। पृष्ठभूमि में काली, धुंधली आकृतियां शामिल हैं जो वनस्पति का संकेत देती हैं। नीचे पेंट के छींटे और दाग का प्रभाव है। नाटकीय, स्पर्शनीय और घिसा हुआ वातावरण।
promptTranslations.es-ES: Ilustración artística de estilo grunge y expresionista de la modelo adjunta, pintada sobre una textura de lienzo rugosa y visible. La obra presenta un dramático alto contraste con un fondo rojo vibrante y saturado que se difumina hacia el negro. El cuerpo de la modelo está pintado en tonos verde azulado oscuro y gris azulado, con un intenso contraluz rojo que ilumina fuertemente su lado derecho, creando un resplandor rojo brillante en los bordes. Se aprecian pinceladas gestuales, sueltas y texturizadas en toda la composición. El fondo incluye siluetas negras y borrosas que sugieren vegetación. La parte inferior tiene un efecto de salpicaduras y manchas de pintura. Atmósfera dramática, táctil y desgastada.

promptTranslations.de-DE: Künstlerische Illustration des beigefügten Modells im Grunge- und expressionistischen Stil, gemalt auf einer rauen und sichtbaren Leinwandstruktur. Das Werk zeichnet sich durch einen dramatischen, starken Kontrast mit einem lebendigen, satten roten Hintergrund aus, der ins Schwarze übergeht. Der Körper des Modells ist in dunklen Petrol- und Blaugrautönen gemalt, wobei ein intensives rotes Gegenlicht ihre rechte Seite stark erleuchtet und an den Rändern ein helles rotes Leuchten erzeugt. In der gesamten Komposition sind gestische, lockere und strukturierte Pinselstriche zu sehen. Der Hintergrund enthält schwarze, verschwommene Silhouetten, die Vegetation andeuten. promptTranslations.fr-FR: Illustration artistique de style grunge et expressionniste du modèle joint, peinte sur une texture de toile brute et visible. promptTranslations.tr-TR: Ekli modelin, pürüzlü ve belirgin bir tuval dokusu üzerine resmedilmiş, granj ve dışavurumcu tarzda sanatsal illüstrasyonu. Eser, siyaha doğru solan canlı, doygun kırmızı bir arka planla dramatik yüksek kontrasta sahiptir. Modelin vücudu koyu camgöbeği ve mavi-gri tonlarında boyanmış olup, yoğun kırmızı bir ters ışık sağ tarafını güçlü bir şekilde aydınlatarak kenarlarda parlak kırmızı bir ışıltı oluşturur. Kompozisyon boyunca jestsel, serbest ve dokulu fırça darbeleri görülebilir. Arka plan, bitki örtüsünü çağrıştıran siyah, bulanık silüetler içerir. Alt kısımda boya sıçraması ve leke efekti bulunur. Dramatik, dokunsal ve yıpranmış bir atmosfer.

post.originalText:
❤️‍🔥🎨 PROMPT SHARE — MIKA VIDEO SPIN

This one was way too cool not to try. 🔥

Amazing prompt shared by @her19845, found via @ScorpionAiArt, with the original creation by @budgetpixel — and thanks @Sealine752 for putting it on my timeline! ❤️

I gave the prompt to Mika… and then decided a still image wasn’t enough. 😂

So here’s my animated Mika spin on it. 🎬✨

Love how the rough grunge texture, red light and dark atmosphere translate into motion.

Original prompt below if you want to try your own version. 👇

Grunge and expressionist style artistic illustration of the attached model, painted on a rough and visible canvas texture. The work features dramatic high contrast with a vibrant, saturated red background that fades to black. The model’s body is painted in dark teal and blue-gray tones, with intense red backlighting strongly illuminating her right side, creating a bright red glow at the edges. Gestural, loose and textured brushstrokes can be seen throughout the composition. The background includes black, blurry silhouettes that suggest vegetation. The bottom has a paint splatter and stain effect. Dramatic, tactile and worn atmosphere.

If you try it, show me what you create! ❤️‍🔥🎨

translations.zh: 附带模型的垃圾摇滚与表现主义风格艺术插画，绘制在粗糙显眼的画布纹理上。画面具有戏剧性的高对比度，鲜艳饱和的红色背景渐变至黑色。模特身体采用深蓝绿与蓝灰冷色调绘制，强烈的红色逆光照亮其右侧，在边缘形成鲜艳红光。整体可见随性松散的肌理笔触，背景含模糊黑色植被剪影，底部带有溅墨污渍效果，呈现戏剧性、可触知且磨损的质感氛围。
translations.en: Grunge and expressionist style artistic illustration of the attached model, painted on a rough and visible canvas texture. The model’s body is painted in dark teal and blue-gray tones, with intense red backlighting strongly illuminating her right side, creating a bright red glow at the edges. Gestural, loose and textured brushstrokes can be seen throughout the composition. The background includes black, blurry silhouettes that suggest vegetation. The bottom has a paint splatter and stain effect. Dramatic, tactile and worn atmosphere.
